episodeTitle.en: Land your dream job in today’s market: negotiation tactics, job search councils, more | Phyl Terry
episodeTitle.zh: 在当今市场中获得理想工作：谈判技巧、求职建议等 | 菲尔·特里（Phyl Terry）

guestBioOfficial.en: Phyl Terry is the author of Never Search Alone, which I’ve seen so many people reference as the most impactful guide they read for finding a job. Phyl was on the founding team of the first company Amazon acquired back in the ’90s and then was CEO of pioneering product consulting firm Creative Good, with companies like Apple, Facebook, and Microsoft as customers. Today, Phyl is the founder and CEO of Collaborative Gain, which 20 years ago pioneered bringing councils to senior product leaders and GMs in Silicon Valley. That’s their day job—in addition to that, Phyl runs a free global community for job seekers based on their latest book. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why you should never search for a job alone
guestBioOfficial.zh: 菲尔·特里（Phyl Terry）是《永不独自求职》一书的作者，我见过许多人将这本书视为他们求职过程中最具影响力的指南。菲尔曾是亚马逊在90年代收购的第一家公司的创始团队成员，随后担任开创性产品咨询公司Creative Good的首席执行官，其客户包括苹果、Facebook和微软等公司。如今，菲尔是Collaborative Gain的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司20年前率先为硅谷的高级产品领导者和总经理引入顾问服务。除此之外，菲尔还基于其最新著作为求职者运营了一个免费的全球社区。在我们的对话中，我们探讨了：• 为何你不应独自求职

title.en: Land your dream job in today’s market: negotiation tactics, job search councils, more | Phyl Terry
title.zh: 在当今市场中获得理想工作：谈判技巧、求职建议等 | 菲尔·特里（Phyl Terry）

summary.en: Phyl argues that job searching should be done with others, not alone, and introduces Job Search Councils: free, volunteer-run support groups of six to eight seekers who meet weekly using a structured methodology. He explains the 'spear, not a net' approach to candidate-market fit and why treating the search like a product exercise reveals focus. The episode is a compassionate, tactical playbook for finding work you love.
summary.zh: Phyl 主张求职应当与他人同行，而非孤军奋战，并介绍了“求职委员会（Job Search Councils）”：由 6-8 名求职者组成、免费且由志愿者运营的互助小组，每周按结构化方法碰面。他阐释了用“长矛而非渔网”的思路去匹配“候选人—市场”契合度，以及为何把求职当作产品练习能让人聚焦。本期是一份充满同理心、可落地的“找到热爱的工作”实战手册。
